name: ISO 128-2 line types
source: ISO 128-2:2020 Technical product documentation (TPD) - General principles of representation - Part 2: Basic conventions for lines (ISO 128-2:2022 is a minor revision with the same tables)
widthsSource: ISO 128-2:2020, 5.1 Line width: 'The width, d, of all types of lines shall be one of the following ... 0,13 mm; 0,18 mm; 0,25 mm; 0,35 mm; 0,5 mm; 0,7 mm; 1 mm; 1,4 mm; 2 mm.' and 'The widths of extra wide, wide and narrow lines are in the ratio 4:2:1.'
patternSource: ISO 128-2:2020, 5.3 Table 4 Lengths of line elements: dot <= d (types 04 to 07, 10 to 15); gap 3d (02, 04 to 15); short dash 6d (08, 09); dash 12d (02, 03, 10 to 15); long dash ~24d (04 to 06, 08, 09); space 18d (03). Patterns below are [element, gap, ...] in multiples of the line width d; dots use d.

types.name: Continuous narrow
types.use: Dimension lines, extension lines, leader lines, hatching, outlines of revolved sections, short centre lines, projection lines
types.source: ISO 128-2:2020, Table 1 no. 01 (continuous) with Table 2 sub-type .1 (narrow); applications in Annex D (mechanical engineering)

types.name: Continuous narrow freehand
types.use: Limits of partial or interrupted views and sections, when the limit is not an axis
types.source: ISO 128-2:2020, Table 1 no. 01 with Table 3 variation 'Freehand / freeform curve continuous line'; applications in Annex D

types.name: Continuous narrow with zigzags
types.use: Limits of partial or interrupted views and sections, drawn by machine
types.source: ISO 128-2:2020, Table 1 no. 01 with Table 3 variation 'Uniform zigzag continuous line'; applications in Annex D

types.name: Continuous wide
types.use: Visible edges and outlines, crests of screw threads, limit of length of full thread
types.source: ISO 128-2:2020, Table 1 no. 01 with Table 2 sub-type .2 (wide); applications in Annex D

types.name: Dashed narrow
types.source: ISO 128-2:2020, Table 1 no. 02 (dashed), Table 2 .1; elements Table 4 (dash 12d, gap 3d); applications in Annex D

types.name: Dashed wide
types.use: Indication of permissible areas of surface treatment
types.source: ISO 128-2:2020, Table 1 no. 02 (dashed), Table 2 .2; elements Table 4 (dash 12d, gap 3d); applications in Annex D

types.name: Long-dashed dotted narrow
types.use: Centre lines, lines of symmetry, pitch circles of gears and of holes
types.source: ISO 128-2:2020, Table 1 no. 04 (long-dashed dotted), Table 2 .1; elements Table 4 (long dash ~24d, gap 3d, dot <= d); applications in Annex D

types.name: Long-dashed dotted wide
types.use: Indication of cutting planes, indication of limited required areas of surface treatment
types.source: ISO 128-2:2020, Table 1 no. 04 (long-dashed dotted), Table 2 .2; elements Table 4; applications in Annex D

types.name: Long-dashed double-dotted narrow
types.use: Outlines of adjacent parts, extreme positions of movable parts, centroidal lines, initial outlines prior to forming, parts in front of a cutting plane
types.source: ISO 128-2:2020, Table 1 no. 05 (long-dashed double-dotted), Table 2 .1; elements Table 4; applications in Annex D
